raw.rationale: Itopride is a peripherally acting dopamine D2 antagonist and acetylcholinesterase inhibitor with poor CNS penetration and no known broad cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to selectively kill any lineage, and PRISM-type screens of similar drugs show selectivity rates near the low base rate. Any apparent lineage effects would be weak and not mechanistically driven by DRD2/CHRM3 dependencies in these lineages.
